The''' Surveyor Probe Mk. IV''', or '''Probe''', often referred to as the '''Little Scout''', is a launchable camera that was created by [[Slate]] to help safely explore hazardous environments. It has several abilities for exploring the [[Solar system]] : Forward and rear facing cameras for taking black-and-white images and detecting [[Ghost Matter]], a distance indicator, a seismic stability indicator (only of use on [[Brittle Hollow]] and on [[Reservoir|The Stranger's dam]]), floodlights, a hazard indicator, and a [[Warp Core|warp core]] for recall to the player.

It can be launched from the spacesuit or from the [[Spaceship|ship]] with the right bumper on an Xbox gamepad or the right mouse button on a default PC keyboard and mouse setup. Launching from the ship will launch the scout at 150m/s.

The probe does not launch straight at the cross-hairs while piloting the spaceship, instead, it launches slightly above and to the right.
==Uses for Exploration==
The probe can be used to photograph the [[Quantum Moon]], locking it into its current position, even if you look away (works the same way on the statue in the [[Observatory]] as well as other quantum objects). Can also be used to distract Anglerfish on the [[Dark Bramble]], locate [[Ghost Matter]], and check the seismic stability of the [[Brittle Hollow]] and [[Reservoir|The Stranger's dam]].

== Trivia ==

* If the scout is launched while on the [[Eye of the Universe]], the player will lose contact with it and be unable to recall it. During the post-credit scene it will fly across the screen in the background.
*Firing the scout while jumping or in space will cause a small thrust that will push you away. Many speedrunners use this to gain velocity.
